summary:
Plan of w128 (requests r8-r12) in plan.md.
Red today: requests.feature unbound, Givens undefined, work has no turn/outcome/resolve; r12 Thens need request-id steps.
Decisions: w128 builds the work outcome and work turn it needs (r8, r9, r12), leaving r16-r18 to w127; request form per 0067 (Outcomes one a line, Resolution per accepted line: n, id verbatim, version); work resolve takes --line <n> <requirement> <version>, ignores turn (r10); resolve on non-accepted refused (Implementation, 0055); every change via workqueue.committed (r12).
Not fixed: notes' D1 (withdraw takes a request) and D2 (model check on requests dir); no accepted scenario needs them.
Tests broken: none (new_commit_holds generalised, plain paths unchanged).
Shared names with w126/w127 (workqueue_request.py, requests_steps.py, test_requests.py) so merges converge; overlap noted as an open case.
